kyteler_host.text: Welcome to Kyteler's. Dame Alice Kyteler lived here in the 1300s, a rich lady with four husbands and a head for business.
In 1324 she was accused of witchcraft, in the first big witch case recorded in Ireland. She escaped to England and was never caught.
Locals say the charges were really about her money. Some swear her ghost tidies the cellar, which is more than I do.
